# Independent Office binary fixtures

The three unmodified `.doc`, `.xls` and `.ppt` files come from Apache POI at
commit `7f4d36854109efa17152b27a5fb1b2c7d842c314`. They are independent inputs,
not generated by Tenshi's CFB parser. Exact source URLs, lengths and SHA256
digests are recorded in `SOURCES.json`. Apache POI's `legal/LICENSE` and
`legal/NOTICE` at that same commit are included alongside the fixtures.

These files are test data only. They are not bundled with the installed Tenshi
application. No Office program, macros, links or embedded actions are executed
by the tests. Parser tests establish structural extent and byte-exact export,
not original-content integrity or rendering of legacy Office documents.
